populationDefinition: Public officials, invited witnesses, and public witnesses in four official NYC Council transcripts whose statements affirmatively supported the issue Jamie championed, including support with stated amendments or conditions. Substantive supportive statements by public officials are included and marked as such. Procedural-only remarks, opposition, neutral expert analysis, and unresolved stances remain in the complete official transcript corpus but are outside this full-text supportive-speaker view.
